description: Building the fish farm management system for GreenFeed as an outsourced project, including its warehouse integration, with Claude Code at the center of the development workflow.

Built and ran the systems behind daily operations at 32 pig farms: production management, warehouse, planning, and sales integrated with SAP and e-invoicing. Background workers sync orders from Odoo to Solomon and process 1,000–2,000 transactions a day.
Built features for the internal lending app covering customer profiles, contracts, loan applications, and disbursement, including money transfers through partner APIs and a MoMo integration.

Built internal tools used by branches nationwide, working across every layer from SQL Server queries and API services to the web interfaces, and planning each feature directly with the people who use it.
Maintained the company’s ERP system and supported outsourcing projects, fixing issues to keep them stable, and wrote cron jobs that collected web data for analysis.
